digest.component_or_area: LLM class config schema and resolver
propositions: rebar lacks a way to map capability tiers to models because cfg.model is a single scalar, so per-pass model decisions are inferred rather than configured.

Three config slots (trivial, standard, frontier) are parsed from the existing layered config, each accepting model, provider, endpoint, and an optional fallback array, with the resolver returning a provider-qualified model string that reuses infer_provider when provider is omitted.

When a slot is unset, each class resolves to today's default bare id (frontier=claude-opus-4-8, standard=claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial=claude-haiku-4-5), preserving current behaviour bit-for-bit as the rollback story.
A slot or fallback entry carrying api_key must be rejected loudly to enforce the env-only secrets boundary.

A fallback entry is a provider target with a slot's fields minus fallback, is non-recursive (a nested fallback is a typed config error), is config-file-only with no env form, and fallback=[] equals an absent fallback key.

load_class_slots reads the model_classes sub-table from the merged [tool.rebar.llm] config, degrading to documented defaults when absent, making the parser reachable from real configuration instead of an orphan.
